text: Rohit Sharma is not from this planet and if you stay till the end I'll prove it.
Let's count down the 5 biggest six-hiters in the history of international cricket at number 5. It's Martin Gaptill tall strong with enormous reach he cleared the rope for New Zealand.
At number 4, it's his ultimate, Brandon Mcllum. All forearms and pure aggression he walked out to attack from the very first ball.
At number 3 we are entering the big leagues Shahid Afridi. They didn't call him boom boom for nothing. He swung at everything with pure muscle and sent it into the crowd.
At number 2, it's the universe boss himself, Kris Gail, 6 foot and 2 inches and build like a heavy weight.
For years, everyone believed that record would never be broken.
And Akdi number one, it's the man who loves his dal chawla man who is never in hurry and who bats like he's in slow motion.
Almost 100 more success than Gail and hits more success per innings than anyone else in the list.
Here is what makes him so special. Every other name on the list hits success with muscle. In cricket, timing is supposed to be the gentle art. The thing Raul Ravidan Kane Williamson used.
to stroke the ball along the ground for four.
Rohit took the same soft timing and aimed it at this kahita, the most graceful skill in the game into a 6 hitting weapon.
So while the giants were muscling it over the rope, doe he bid every one of them and he made it look effortless.
That's why I say he's not from this planet. Muscle or Timing, drop one word below and follow for more stories like this.
